name: Aadhaar Card
description: India's unique identity document issued by UIDAI. Required for most government services, bank accounts, and subsidies.
benefits: Universal ID for all government services, direct benefit transfers, e-KYC

name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
description: Direct income support of ₹6,000/year to small and marginal farmer families in three equal installments.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers with cultivable land up to 2 hectares
benefits: ₹6,000 per year in three installments of ₹2,000 each

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
description: World's largest health insurance scheme providing ₹5 lakh/family/year cashless hospitalization at empanelled hospitals.
eligibility: Families identified through SECC 2011 data, or state-specific criteria
benefits: ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization

name: Ration Card / NFSA
description: Public Distribution System card for subsidized food grains under National Food Security Act.
eligibility: Priority households and Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) families as per state criteria
apply_url: Visit nearest Food & Supply office or state PDS portal

name: Voter ID (EPIC)
description: Electors Photo Identity Card for voting in elections. Form 6 is for new voter registration.
eligibility: Indian citizen aged 18+ years, ordinary resident of the constituency
benefits: Right to vote, accepted as valid ID proof

name: PAN Card
description: Permanent Account Number for tax identification. Required for financial transactions above specified limits.
eligibility: Any person/entity required to file income tax returns or conduct specified financial transactions
benefits: Tax compliance, mandatory for bank accounts, property purchase, high-value transactions

name: Udyam Registration (MSME)
description: Government registration for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises. Replaces earlier Udyog Aadhaar.
eligibility: Enterprises meeting MSME investment and turnover criteria
benefits: Priority sector lending, subsidy on loans, preference in government tenders, ISO certification reimbursement

name: Birth Certificate
description: Official record of birth issued by municipal corporation or gram panchayat. Essential for school admission, passport, etc.
eligibility: Parents/guardians of a child born in India
benefits: Proof of age and citizenship, required for school admission, passport, government schemes
apply_url: Visit local municipal corporation or apply through state e-district portal

name: Caste/Income Certificate
description: Certificate proving caste category (SC/ST/OBC/EWS) or income level for reservation and scholarship benefits.
eligibility: Residents belonging to notified categories or below specified income threshold
benefits: Educational reservations, job reservations, fee waivers, scholarships
apply_url: State e-district portal or Tehsil/SDM office

name: Land Records (7/12 Extract / Khatauni)
description: Official land ownership and cultivation records maintained by state revenue departments.
benefits: Proof of ownership, required for agricultural loans, government schemes, property transactions
apply_url: State land records portal (varies by state)
